scripts.install:all: ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD=1 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run setup:browser
scripts.setup:browser: pnpm --dir tooling/dshx exec playwright install --only-shell chromium
scripts.check:dshx: pnpm --dir tooling/dshx run check && pnpm --dir tooling/dshx run deps:check
scripts.check: pnpm run check:green && pnpm run lint && pnpm run fmt:check
scripts.check:green: pnpm run typecheck:scripts && pnpm run test:scripts && pnpm run verify:web-profile-contract && pnpm run check:dshx && pnpm run check:plugins && pnpm run check:desktop && pnpm run knip && pnpm run check:plugin-boot && pnpm run check:e2e:smoke
scripts.lint: node scripts/lint-ratchet.ts oxlint && node scripts/lint-ratchet.ts ast-grep
scripts.sg: ast-grep scan tooling/dshx/packages plugins scripts apps/desktop/src --globs=!plugins/@dshfiles/rich-composer/src/native/**
scripts.test:tooling: pnpm --dir tooling/dshx run test:evidence && pnpm --dir tooling/dshx run test:inventory && pnpm --dir tooling/dshx run test:feature-coverage && pnpm --dir tooling/dshx run test:browser-tasks
